subtitle: It’s super simple
steps: You tell me the dates you’ll send your materials
example: “I’ll have three galleries in November: on the 10th, 20th and 30th.”
result: We confirm the dates, I block off time in my schedule, and you know exactly when to expect your edited photos.

important.title: Important
important.text: Booking means reserving my working time for your order.
important.warning: If files aren’t delivered on the agreed date without prior notice, the guaranteed deadlines no longer apply. New ones depend on my current workload.
important.closing: Plans change, I understand that. What matters is letting me know in advance.
important.cta: To book or place a new order, send me a DM.
